# Power steering fluid level and foam issues

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Slowly pour power steering fluid to fix foamy levels from an unburped system. [t2289]

## Parts

- [Partial] Reservoir: Level stays even despite leaks. [t2289]

## Tips & gotchas

- Foamy fluid and a whining pump suggest the system wasn't burped after filling. [t2289]
- Slowly pouring more fluid into the reservoir can fix foam caused by trapped air. [t2289]
